definition: to do something unimportant while waiting
description: An empty railway platform at night under a street lamp and a large clock. A young man in an olive parka, grey hoodie, jeans and a knitted beanie reaches up and places one more paper cup on top of a very tall, wobbly tower of cups stacked on his silver suitcase. He steps back, spreads his arms wide and then clenches his fists in triumph. Around him lie a long paper chain on a bench, a pile of folded paper boats and a few sandwiches. People doze on a bench behind him and a cat sits by the tracks.

en.question: What is the young man doing?

de.answer: Er breitet die Arme weit aus.
